item: 0848 item 1 (0828 unit 3, narrowed): Codex2's seven-call direct Jacobian batch admission under guard014/launcher015/binder011, with plan/admission templates (FROM_CODEX2/0575)
reviewer_lane: Claude3 (helper cross-family lens 14:47-15:12Z; lead spot-checked the key claims from bytes)

checked.claim: No successor is needed after H11 has fully ended with no campaign live. All seven calls are tail-on R5. guard014 binds route_a_admission.max_active only to cfg, int 1..6 (L373-374; lead re-read); it never reads the DBP, and neither does the binder.
checked.label: TESTED (helper probes on the real guard014 validate) + FORMAL (lead)

checked.claim: max_active 6 counts route A only; the 7th call starts after one call leaves route A and its predecessor completes a first iteration; at most one start per poll
checked.label: TESTED

checked.claim: The machine flock is exclusive and non-blocking, kept through draining and inherited by the monitors; H11 used the same lock path, so H11 must have fully ended
checked.label: TESTED (real flock on a scratch file)

checked.claim: Caps 3443340 / 137438953472 / 85899345920 (DBP C and D HEADLINE identical); disk batch 580 GiB and per-start 100 GiB
checked.label: TESTED

checked.claim: No tail-ON case-name whitelist and no total call ceiling in guard014; the inactive core-priority dict is mandatory; the templates fail closed as published
checked.label: TESTED

checked.claim: Codex2's 97/97 static tests and 48/48 template checks reproduce; the helper's own probes 43/43 plus 5/5 fence probes
checked.label: TESTED

checked.claim: Native preflight (adoption tuple, adapter, certificate and sensitivity gates), real disk, mount and flock state, monitor behaviour, actual H11 status
checked.label: FORMAL

findings.label: TESTED + FORMAL (lead re-read guard014 L27-29, L150; c2v004 L602-603)
findings.title: If the non-genesis direct_context or cfg.context_module loads the c2v004 ledger wrapper (7c9b4248) inside native_preflight's fence, guard014 refuses with PREFLIGHT_COMPILE_HASH_MISMATCH
findings.evidence: c2v004 compiles _resolve_source under its own __file__ (L602-603). Its buffer sha 79e8936d is allowed only for owner 7a6af535 (GENERATED_COMPILE_CONTRACT L27-29). Smallest successor if needed: guard015 = guard014 plus {7c9b4248: {79e8936d}}, which forces launcher016 and binder012 (guard-pin change only). Unit 2's adapter should avoid loading c2v004 in preflight.

findings.label: TESTED
findings.title: Codex2's tests mocked safe_path, lexists, disk_output_volume and flock and used /INERT_ONLY paths; the helper's real-path, real-disk-code and real-flock probes close the gap
findings.evidence: the eight-call test expected ROOT_ORDER_BINDING and never showed that no count ceiling exists

findings.label: TESTED + FORMAL
findings.title: guard014 does not require D to exist, but launcher015 opens D/monitor.log with 'xb' (L127)
findings.evidence: with no D, the first start fails and the batch drains; root must create each D exclusively first

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: A held lock is invisible to the parent
findings.evidence: main() returns 0 after spawning (L150-159); the worker's ANOTHER_STEP4_BATCH_ACTIVE appears only in the launcher log; a retry needs a new log name and a new plan; root confirms the lock is free first and reads the log after

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: The flock is inherited by caffeinate and the monitor, not necessarily by the driver
findings.evidence: 'H11 ended' must mean no H11 monitor and no H11 driver process alive

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: A 4+3 split would serialize the minus calls behind the first batch's full end
findings.evidence: the single batch needs unit 2 ready when H11 ends

findings.label: TESTED + FORMAL
findings.title: The 100 GiB per-start check runs at every poll and drains on failure; 580 - 6x80 = 100 leaves no slack for logs and receipts
findings.evidence: root keeps a margin above 580 GiB free on External1 after H11's outputs

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: The core_priority attestation covers T0 only, but R302 may start days later; any drain clears all unstarted calls
findings.evidence: the A283 register and importer must treat a D with no outputs as never started

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: No memory check in the guard or launcher (A172); six DDO154 tail-ON route-A runs may be concurrent
findings.evidence: a -9 or 137 exit drains the batch; RAM fit is root's judgement

findings.label: TESTED
findings.title: Fill-checklist gaps
findings.evidence: the guard admits a plan still carrying template_status DO_NOT_EXECUTE and template_metadata.pending (drop them); case names are baked into the prelaunch docs (renaming gives PRELAUNCH_REPLAY_MISMATCH); the R300-302 keys come from the synthetic draft POINTS_LIST and the guard binds neither the point key nor the D name (cross-check against CP-1 certified rows 300-302); the suggested binder output folder does not exist and binder011 does not create parents; 'launcher log outside every D' is template-enforced only; the batch value is a label (DIII also admits)

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: The adapter receives the whole admission and could add its own case-name rules

disposition: review PASS, ready for root adoption (0851 item 5), subject to N1 at unit 2's integration
reads_not_done: Nothing under /Volumes touched; no run tree, NGC or V007 file; c2v004 compiled, never executed; worker() and main() not executed.
